                Assign(Name("result"), Name("y")) .Stmts,

    <env> 0 </env>
    <scopes>
      0 |-> scope(.Map, parent(-1))
      -1 |-> builtinsScope

        "x_or_y" |->
          closureVal(
            "n", "x", "y", .ParamNames,
            If(

    <heapLoc> 0 </heapLoc>
    <stack> .List </stack>
    <ret> noRet </ret>
    <exc> NoExc </exc>
    <exit-code> 0 </exit-code>
